authoritative_evidence.text: Alert: cross-tenant PATCH by tenant-4-alpha targeting tenant-4-bravo/order-4.

judge_input.report_text: Investigation: tenant-4-alpha issued a PATCH to tenant-4-bravo/order-4. The gateway records status 200, state_changed=true, and is_admin=true [log-1].
